origins-forge.title: Origins (Forge)
origins-forge.body: Origins (Forge) ================== This project has been discontinued, it will no longer receive updates. This is an unofficial forge port of the [Origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins) mod for fabric. Please support the original work. This mod is designed with feature parity with the fabric version in mind. As such, no content will be added or removed from the original mod. Features ------------------ This mod adds 9 new origins to the game: ### Enderian * Can teleport * Increased reach * Takes damage in water or rain * Cannot see entities wearing pumpkins ### Merling * Unlimited underwater breathing * Increased sight underwater * Has aqua affinity * Swims faster * Ignores gravity underwater * Cannot breathe on land ### Phantom * Can phase through blocks in Phantom state * Is invisible in Phantom state * Burns in daylight while not in Phantom state * Hungers faster in Phantom state. * Only has 7 hearts. ### Elytrian * Has a built-in Elytra * Can launch themself in the air * Takes more kinetic damage * Can only wear up to Chainmail * Takes more fall damage * Gets slowness and weakness over time in low ceiling areas. ### Blazeborn * Immune to fire and lava * Deals more damage when on fire * Immune to Hunger and Poison * Spawns in the nether * Takes damage in water or rain ### Avian * Slow fall * Air speed is equal to ground speed * Increased speed * Lays an egg after waking up * Needs to sleep high in the world * Can't eat meat ### Arachnid * Can climb like a spider * Places cobwebs when attacks * Isn't slowed by cobwebs * Can see targets in foes in cobwebs * Can craft cobwebs from string * Only has 7 health * Can only eat meat ### Shulk * 9 Additional slots accessible by pressing the power key (Kept on death) * Has builtin armor * Can break stone without tools * Can't use shields * Hungers faster ### Feline * No fall damage * Jumps higher when sprinting * Sees slightly better in the dark * Scares creepers * Can only mine small clusters of stone * Only has 9 hearts Powers can be activated by a keybinding. simply-fantastical-origins.title: Simply Fantastical Origins
simply-fantastical-origins.body: Adds several simple fantasy origins to the Origins mod ### Dragonborn Humanoid descendants of the most powerful creatures in history, Dragonborn still retain some of their ancestors' mythical capabilities. ### Dwarf Dwarves are a species of miners, adapted to the caves and often found in them. They are a secretive sort and little is known about them save that they greatly dislike elves. ### Elf Elves are a sophisticated but arrogant sort, believing themselves to be above all others. Their attitude is generally considered annoying, but none can deny the power of their archery. ### Halfling Halflings are a small species, naturally attuned to nature. ### Lizardfolk Lizardfolk are an amphibious species of poison-resistant reptillians, often found in swamps and similar biomes. ### Orc Orcs are a powerful species of great stature and vitality, capable of incredible feats of strength. ### Tabaxi Tabaxi are a small and delicate species, but make up for it with their unmatched agility reminiscent of their feline cousins. ### Tiefling Tieflings are a demonic people born of fire, harnessing its power to slay their foes. ### Gargoyle Squat, stony sentinels. Gargoyles are a monstrous species. ### Goblin Little-small sneaky monster-peoples. Muchly fast-speedy and lucky. ### Ogre A very big and tough monstrous species. ### Wraith They are always there. Especially when you do not see them.

runeblood-origin.title: Runeblood: Origin
runeblood-origin.body: # ⚔️ Runeblood: Origins Runeblood: Origins is a massive, highly detailed expansion for the Origins mod that introduces 13 brand new, mythology-inspired fantasy races to your Minecraft world. Designed with a heavy focus on deep lore, balanced gameplay, and unique combat mechanics, this datapack/resource pack transforms how you play. Each race comes with its own set of powerful active abilities, passive traits, and severe weaknesses that force you to adapt your playstyle. ## ✨ **Features** 13 Unique Races: Play as everything from the sky-dwelling Aetherborn to the gold-obsessed Goblins. Balanced Gameplay: Every origin has been carefully tuned. Incredible powers are offset by crippling weaknesses (e.g., Infernals die in water, Voidborn burn in sunlight). Deep Lore: Every race is rooted in real-world mythology and fantasy literature, complete with rich in-game descriptions. Bilingual Support: Fully translated into English (US) and Spanish (Spain). ## 🧬 **The Origins** Here is a glimpse of the bloodlines you can choose from: 🦅 Aetherborn (Sylphs): Born of the wind. You have absolute freedom of flight and immunity to fall damage, but stepping on the earth corrupts your form and makes you incredibly fragile. 🐉 Dragonkin: Descendants of Tiamat. You can breathe fire and possess impenetrable scales, but your draconic biology demands a strict carnivore diet and water burns you from the inside out. 🌑 Voidborn: Creatures of the space between worlds. You can teleport and resist negative effects, but the light of the sun slowly destroys you. 🔥 Infernal (Ifrit): Forged from smokeless fire. You are completely immune to lava and can set enemies ablaze with your touch, but water is your ultimate doom. ⛰️ Stoneborn (Dvergar): Dwarves of living stone. You are immovable and highly resistant to explosions, but your heavy body makes you much slower than creatures of flesh. 🐻 Owlbear: Colossal beasts of the forest. You possess devastating brute strength and can cause seismic shockwaves by falling, but your sheer size makes you clumsy. 🌩️ Stormcaller: Messengers of the thunder gods. You move like lightning and summon thunder upon killing your enemies, but water short-circuits your powers

pehkui.title: Pehkui
pehkui.body: This mod allows for most entities to have their size changed, either enlarging or shrinking them.   It also provides an API that other mods can make use of to manipulate the size of entities and the time it takes for their size to change.     The Quilt/Fabric version is the actively supported version and will receive features, updates, and fixes first. The NeoForge and Forge versions are not supported as actively.     For the ***Quilt/Fabric*** version, the ***most recently released jar*** can be used on: ***1.21, 1.20.6, 1.20.4, 1.20.2, 1.20.1, 1.19.4, 1.19.2, 1.18.2, 1.17.1, 1.16.5, 1.15.2, and 1.14.4***. For the ***NeoForge*** version, there are ***separate jars*** for each supported Minecraft version. Those jars are for: ***1.21, 1.20.6, 1.20.4, and 1.20.2***. For the ***Forge*** version, there are ***separate jars*** for each supported Minecraft version. Those jars are for: ***1.20.1, 1.19.4, 1.19.2, 1.18.2, 1.17.1, and 1.16.5***.     Removing this mod will revert entities back to their normal size. Adding it back in will ***not*** restore their size.     If you have no mods that add ways to rescale entities, you can modify and view the scale and scaling delay of an entity in-game using the `/scale` command if you have operator permissions:   `/scale set [ ]` `/scale set [ ]` `/scale (add|subtract|multiply|divide) [ ]` `/scale (add|subtract|multiply|divide) [ ]` `/scale get [ ]` `/scale get [ ]` `/scale compute [ ]` `/scale delay set [ ]` `/scale delay set [ ]` `/scale delay get [ ]` `/scale delay get [ ]` `/scale reset [ ]` `/scale reset [ ]` `/scale nbt get [ ]`     If you want your scale to persist after you respawn, there's a `/scale` subcommand for that as well:   `/scale persist set (true|false) [ ]` `/scale persist set (true|false) [ ]` `/scale persist get [ ]` `/scale persist reset [ ]` `/scale persist reset [ ]`     The following scale types are added by default:   `pehkui:base`: Generic scale type for easily affecting other scales `pehkui:width`: Modifies width/length/depth (affected by `pehkui:base`) `pehkui:height`: Modifies height (affected by `pehkui:base`)

caelus.title: Caelus API
caelus.body: Caelus is a small utility mod that abstracts the hardcoded vanilla elytra behavior into a more generic elytra flight attribute and exposes this to mod developers seeking to implement elytra flight for their own mods. All modders have to do is call `CaelusApi.getInstance().getFallFlyingAttribute()` wherever they want to apply a modifier to the flight attribute. The attribute has a default value of 0, which forbids any elytra flight. Attribute values greater than or equal to 1 will enable elytra flight. The vanilla elytra item has also been changed to use this attribute, keeping its behavior the same as normal. For more information on how to interact with the attribute, see the [Minecraft wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Attribute). ## Adding to Your Project: Add the following to your build.gradle file: ``` repositories { maven { name = 'C4's Maven' url = "https://maven.theillusivec4.top/" } } ``` ### Forge ``` dependencies { runtimeOnly "com.illusivesoulworks.caelus:caelus-forge:${version}" compileOnly "com.illusivesoulworks.caelus:caelus-forge:${version}:api" } ``` ### NeoForge ``` dependencies { runtimeOnly "com.illusivesoulworks.caelus:caelus-neoforge:${version}" compileOnly "com.illusivesoulworks.caelus:caelus-neoforge:${version}:api" } ``` Replace ${version} with the version of Caelus that you want to use. ## Support Please report all bugs, issues, and feature requests to the [issue tracker](https://github.com/illusivesoulworks/caelus/issues). For non-technical support and questions, join the developer's [Discord](https://discord.gg/JWgrdwt). ## License All source code and assets are licensed under LGPL-3.0-or-later. ## Donations Donations to the developer can be sent through [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/C0C1NL4O). ## Affiliates [ ](https://illusivesoulworks.com/affiliate)

icarus.title: Icarus
icarus.body: Icarus is a small mod that adds a variety of colourful and unique wings that can be worn in the Back (Curios) or Cape (Trinkets) slot. The wings only have two drawbacks: they cost hunger while flying, and their max speed gets slowed down when wearing armour. The more armour you're wearing, the more you get slowed down, up to 2/3 of your normal max speed (configurable). There is also a tag that can have wings added to it via a datapack so that they don't use up hunger while flying. # Check out this awesome showcase by [Zeddy](https://www.youtube.com/@zeddyminecraft): # New Stamina System! --- ### Recipes: --- Join my Discord Join my Ko-Fi!
